tool_args.rationale: The five observations share H, x_now, mem_conv, and u_past, leaving the hydraulic-siphon branch contribution unidentified. The open-branch probe directly addresses this ambiguity; the short forecast horizon does not justify a slow-horizon probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled mechanism includes an unresolved branch term; current observations hold the other state variables fixed and do not identify its behavior.
The pilot signatures are smooth and monotone-concave, so resolving branch behavior is more informative than denser sampling.
It is unrelated to the identified branch ambiguity and should not be purchased.
